about: Secret for the commemoration of Saint Petronilla. We ask that the offering in honor of the saints may be pleasing to God, acknowledging the help received through their merits.

seg.tr: Lord, may the offering of the consecrated people in honor of Your saints be acceptable to You. The people recognize that through these saints’ merits they have received help in their distress.

a.g: have received help, as they acknowledge

ex.w001: The subject is the offering, named later in the Latin. The prayer asks that it be acceptable to God, rather than stating that acceptance has already happened.
ex.w005: The people are described as consecrated, not identified as clergy alone.
ex.w013: Se is the subject of receiving the help, referring to the people. Quorum refers to the saints whose merits are named.
ex.w016: The phrase describes help in distress, with a sense of relief from it. It does not claim that every affliction has ended.
ex.w018: The same people are understood as the ones who recognize, although plebis earlier stands in the genitive. Their receiving the help comes before this recognition.

seg.tr: Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: who lives and reigns with You

ex.w036: God describes Christ, the Son, not the Father being addressed. The Son lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
